en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large institutional building complex, likely a school or municipal facility, in an early‑20th‑century European city. The central block is a symmetrical four‑storey structure with a steep hipped roof, dormer windows, and stone foundation, flanked by two slightly smaller side wings of similar design. In front is a landscaped garden and lawn enclosed by a tall picket-and-pillar fence along a cobbled street with young trees and a streetlamp. Several children stand on the sidewalk near the fence, suggesting a school environment. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
